page.title: 一般動詞はdo、be文はbeで否定

analysis.summaryJa: 一般動詞の否定は主語と時制をdo・does・didが引き受け、その後ろの動詞を原形にする。一方、状態や説明を結ぶbe文ではbe動詞の直後にnotを置く。画像の二つの操作盤と語順レーンを根拠に、短縮形を含む現在・過去の否定を使い分ける。
grammarPoints: 一般動詞の現在否定はdo notまたはdoes not＋動詞原形
一般動詞の過去否定は主語にかかわらずdid not＋動詞原形
be文の否定はam・is・are・was・wereの直後にnotを置く
is not・are not・was not・were notの短縮形とam notの扱い
visualEvidence: 画像左のDO NOT操作盤が一般動詞とdo・does・didの組合せを示す
画像右のBE NOT操作盤がbe動詞＋not＋説明の語順を示す
現在の三人称単数と過去では時制・一致を助動詞が担当し、本動詞は原形になるレーンが描かれる
短縮形isn’t・aren’t・wasn’t・weren’tとam notはそのままという一覧がある
commonTraps: doesn’tやdidn’tの後ろに三単現形や過去形を重ねる
一般動詞文をbe not＋動詞で否定する
be文の否定にdo notを加える
複数主語にisn’t、単数主語にaren’tを使う

questions.prompt: The billing system ------- accept expired discount codes.

choices.A: don't

questions.translationJa: 請求システムは期限切れの割引コードを受け付けません。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語systemの現在の一般動詞を否定するのでdoesn’t＋原形acceptを使います。

questions.prompt: Our regional offices ------- close during the lunch hour.

choices.A: don't

questions.translationJa: 当社の地方事務所は昼休みに閉まりません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語officesの習慣的な一般動詞closeの否定にはdon’tを置きます。

questions.prompt: The courier ------- deliver the replacement unit yesterday.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: 配達員は昨日、交換品を配達しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayで過去なのでdidn’tを使い、その後ろは原形deliverです。

questions.prompt: The west elevator ------- available after 8:00 p.m.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: 西側のエレベーターは午後8時以降は利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: availableは状態を表す説明なのでbe文をisn’tで否定します。

questions.prompt: The service charges ------- included in the quoted price.

choices.A: aren't

questions.translationJa: サービス料は見積価格に含まれていません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語chargesを受動のbe文で否定するためaren’t includedが正解です。

questions.prompt: The conference room ------- ready when the guests arrived.

choices.A: didn't

questions.translationJa: 来客が到着したとき、会議室は準備できていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の単数主語roomの状態を否定するのでwasn’tを使います。

questions.prompt: The loading doors ------- open during the safety inspection.

choices.A: didn't

questions.translationJa: 安全点検中、搬入口の扉は開いていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の複数主語doorsと形容詞openを結ぶbe動詞はwereなのでweren’tです。

questions.prompt: I ------- authorized to approve refunds above $500.

choices.A: don't

questions.translationJa: 私は500ドルを超える返金を承認する権限がありません。
questions.explanationJa: 主語Iの現在のbe文はam notで否定します。標準的な短縮形amn’tは使いません。

questions.prompt: This maintenance plan ------- require an annual contract.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: この保守プランには年間契約は必要ありません。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語planの現在否定はdoesn’t＋原形requireです。

questions.prompt: Ms. Vega ------- send the revised itinerary last night.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: ベガさんは昨夜、修正版の日程表を送りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: last nightが過去を示すためdidn’t sendとし、sentを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a store policy.

choices.A: The store does not accepts personal checks.
choices.B: The store is not accept personal checks.
choices.C: The store do not accept personal checks.
choices.D: The store does not accept personal checks.

questions.translationJa: その店では個人小切手を受け付けません。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語The storeにはdoes notを使い、acceptは原形にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the customer records.

choices.A: The customer records do not complete.
choices.B: The customer records are not complete.
choices.C: The customer records is not complete.
choices.D: The customer records are not completing.

questions.translationJa: 顧客記録は完全ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語recordsの状態を表すbe文なのでare not completeが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about yesterday’s shipment.

choices.A: The supplier did not shipped the order yesterday.
choices.B: The supplier was not ship the order yesterday.
choices.C: The supplier did not ship the order yesterday.
choices.D: The supplier does not ship the order yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は昨日その注文品を発送しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did notが過去を担当するため本動詞は原形shipになります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an unavailable manager.

choices.A: The branch manager is not in the office today.
choices.B: The branch manager does not in the office today.
choices.C: The branch manager not is in the office today.
choices.D: The branch manager are not in the office today.

questions.translationJa: 支店長は今日オフィスにいません。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の説明をするbe文ではisの直後にnotを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two printers.

choices.A: The printers does not support wireless connections.
choices.B: The printers do not supports wireless connections.
choices.C: The printers are not support wireless connections.
choices.D: The printers do not support wireless connections.

questions.translationJa: そのプリンター2台は無線接続に対応していません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語printersにはdo not＋原形supportを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a canceled appointment.

choices.A: The appointment did not on our calendar.
choices.B: The appointment was not be on our calendar.
choices.C: The appointment was not on our calendar.
choices.D: The appointment were not on our calendar.

questions.translationJa: その予約は当社の予定表に載っていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の単数be文なのでwas not＋場所表現が正しい語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about employee access.

choices.A: New employees do not eligible for remote access immediately.
choices.B: New employees are not eligible for remote access immediately.
choices.C: New employees is not eligible for remote access immediately.
choices.D: New employees not are eligible for remote access immediately.

questions.translationJa: 新入社員はすぐにはリモートアクセスの対象になりません。
questions.explanationJa: eligibleは形容詞で、複数主語employeesにはare notを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a missed phone call.

choices.A: I did not recognized the number, so I did not answered.
choices.B: I was not recognize the number, so I was not answer.
choices.C: I do not recognized the number, so I did not answer.
choices.D: I did not recognize the number, so I did not answer.

questions.translationJa: 番号が分からなかったので、私は電話に出ませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の一般動詞recognizeとanswerはどちらもdid not＋原形にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a closed facility.

choices.A: The fitness center does not open on public holidays.
choices.B: The fitness center is not opens on public holidays.
choices.C: The fitness center is not open on public holidays.
choices.D: The fitness center do not be open on public holidays.

questions.translationJa: そのフィットネスセンターは祝日には営業していません。
questions.explanationJa: openを形容詞として営業状態を述べるためis not openが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an optional fee.

choices.A: The delivery fee is not mandatory for in-store pickup.
choices.B: The delivery fee does not mandatory for in-store pickup.
choices.C: The delivery fee are not mandatory for in-store pickup.
choices.D: The delivery fee not is mandatory for in-store pickup.

questions.translationJa: 店頭受け取りの場合、配送料は必須ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語feeと形容詞mandatoryを結ぶisの後ろにnotを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The kiosk does not print paper receipts."

choices.A: The kiosk prints no paper receipts.
choices.B: The kiosk did not print a receipt on one occasion.
choices.C: The kiosk is unable to display digital receipts.
choices.D: Every receipt from the kiosk is printed on paper.

questions.translationJa: その端末は紙のレシートを印刷しません。
questions.explanationJa: does not printは現在の通常機能の否定で、prints no paper receiptsが同じ内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The meeting rooms were not occupied."

choices.A: The meeting rooms are occupied now.
choices.B: No one was allowed to reserve a room.
choices.C: The meeting was moved to an occupied room.

questions.translationJa: 会議室は空いていました。
questions.explanationJa: were not occupiedは人に使われていなかった、つまりwere emptyという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Mr. Park did not approve the request."

choices.A: Mr. Park approved a different request.
choices.B: The request was approved before Mr. Park saw it.
choices.C: The request did not receive Mr. Park’s approval.
choices.D: Mr. Park has not read any request yet.

questions.translationJa: その申請はパクさんの承認を得ませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: did not approveを、requestを主語にしてdid not receive ... approvalと同じ過去の否定で表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "These seats are not reserved."

choices.A: These seats cannot be used by guests.
choices.B: These seats are available to any guest.
choices.C: Every seat has a reservation card.
choices.D: Only staff members may reserve these seats.

questions.translationJa: これらの席はどの来客でも利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: not reservedは予約済みではないため、利用可能だというAの内容が最も近い意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The warranty does not cover accidental damage."

choices.A: Accidental damage is excluded from the warranty.
choices.B: The warranty covers only accidental damage.
choices.C: The damaged item has no warranty number.
choices.D: Accidents do not damage this product.

questions.translationJa: 偶発的な損傷は保証の対象外です。
questions.explanationJa: does not coverは対象に含めないという意味で、is excluded from the warrantyと対応します。
questions.focus: 一般動詞否定と受動表現

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I am not responsible for room assignments."

choices.A: I have not received my room assignment.
choices.B: No rooms have been assigned to our team.
choices.C: Room assignments are handled by someone else.

questions.translationJa: 部屋割りは別の担当者が扱います。
questions.explanationJa: am not responsibleは自分の担当ではないことを表すため、別の人が扱うという文が同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The packages did not arrive before noon."

choices.A: The packages always arrive before noon.
choices.B: The packages were opened before noon.
choices.D: The packages arrived at noon or later.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は正午以降に到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: did not arrive before noonは正午より前には到着しなかったという時間関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The two estimates are not identical."

choices.A: The estimates differ from each other.
choices.C: Both estimates contain the same figures.

questions.translationJa: 2つの見積書は互いに異なります。
questions.explanationJa: are not identicalは同一ではない、つまりdiffer from each otherと同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Our office does not use that booking platform."

choices.A: Our office designed that booking platform.
choices.B: That platform is not used by our office.
choices.C: The platform does not allow office bookings.
choices.D: Our office used the platform in the past only.

questions.translationJa: その予約プラットフォームは当社では使用していません。
questions.explanationJa: 能動のdoes not useを受動のis not usedに変えて同じ現在の否定を保っています。
questions.focus: 現在否定の能動・受動

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The lobby was not crowded this morning."

choices.A: The lobby was closed throughout the morning.
choices.B: A large crowd entered the lobby this morning.
choices.C: There were few people in the lobby this morning.
choices.D: The lobby is usually crowded in the afternoon.

questions.translationJa: 今朝、ロビーには人がほとんどいませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: was not crowdedは混雑していなかったことで、few people were thereが近い意味です。

questions.prompt: The online form is for domestic orders only. It ------- process requests from overseas addresses.

choices.A: isn't

questions.translationJa: オンラインフォームは国内注文専用です。海外住所からの依頼は処理しません。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語Itの現在の一般動詞processを否定するのでdoesn’t＋原形です。

questions.prompt: The inventory count finished at 6:00 p.m. Several shelves ------- fully checked by that time.

choices.A: didn't

questions.translationJa: 棚卸しは午後6時に終わりました。その時点で、いくつかの棚は完全には確認されていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語shelvesの過去の受動状態を否定するためweren’t checkedを使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Rios usually takes the express train. She ------- drive to the branch office on weekdays.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: リオスさんは普段急行列車を利用します。平日に支店まで車を運転することはありません。
questions.explanationJa: 習慣の現在否定で主語Sheは三人称単数なのでdoesn’t driveです。

questions.prompt: The technician tested the scanner twice yesterday. It still ------- read the damaged barcode.

choices.A: doesn't

questions.translationJa: 技術者は昨日スキャナーを2度試しました。それでも破損したバーコードを読み取りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の文脈なのでdidn’t＋原形readが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: We can issue a digital copy immediately. However, the printed manuals ------- ready for collection yet.

choices.A: don't

questions.translationJa: デジタル版はすぐ発行できます。しかし、印刷版のマニュアルはまだ受け取れる状態ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語manualsの現在の状態を否定するのでaren’t readyです。

questions.prompt: I reviewed the contract, but I ------- familiar with the local tax clause.

choices.A: don't

questions.translationJa: 契約書を確認しましたが、私は現地の税条項に詳しくありません。
questions.explanationJa: 主語Iと形容詞familiarの現在be文はam notで否定します。

questions.prompt: The seminar starts at nine tomorrow. The keynote speaker ------- arrive before 8:30.

choices.A: won't

questions.translationJa: セミナーは明日9時に始まります。基調講演者は8時30分より前には到着しない予定です。
questions.explanationJa: willの否定はwill notまたはwon’tで、本動詞arriveは原形です。

questions.prompt: The alarm sounded at midnight. Fortunately, no employees ------- inside the warehouse then.

choices.A: weren't

questions.translationJa: 警報は真夜中に鳴りました。幸い、その時倉庫内に従業員はいませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: no employees自体が否定を含み、複数主語の過去be動詞wereを使います。二重否定にしません。

questions.prompt: The revised plan reduces costs, but it ------- solve the staffing shortage.

choices.A: isn't

questions.translationJa: 修正案は費用を減らしますが、人員不足は解決しません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の単数主語itにdoesn’t＋原形solveを使います。

questions.prompt: The north entrance was under repair. It ------- accessible to wheelchair users during the work.

choices.A: didn't

questions.translationJa: 北側入口は修理中でした。工事中は車いす利用者が利用できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の単数主語Itの状態なのでwasn’t accessibleが正解です。
